verses.translation: At that time, saith the Lord, I will be a God to the family of Israel, and they shall be to me a people.

translations.ron: Şi Şefatia, fiul lui Matan, şi Ghedalia, fiul lui Pashor, Iucal, fiul lui Şelemia şi Paşhurr, fiul lui Malchia, au auzit cuvintele pe care le-a rostit Ieremia către tot poporul, zicând:
translations.grk: Ἐν τῷ χρόνῳ ἐκείνῳ, εἶπε Κύριος, ἔσομαι εἰς Θεὸν τῷ γένει Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν.

verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord, I found him warm in the wilderness with them that were slain with the sword: go ye and destroy not Israel.

translations.ron: Aşa zice Domnul: Cine va rămâne în această cetate va muri de sabie, de foame şi de boala ciumei; iar cel ce se va duce la Caldei va trăi, va avea ca pradă viaţa lui şi va rămâne viu.
translations.grk: Οὕτως εἶπε Κύριος, εὗρον θερμὸν ἐν ἐρήμῳ μετὰ ὀλωλότων ἐν μαχαίρᾳ· βαδίσατε, καὶ μὴ ὀλέσητε τὸν Ἰσραὴλ.

verses.translation: The Lord appeared to him from afar, saying, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore have I drawn thee in compassion.

translations.ron: Aşa zice Domnul: Cetatea aceasta va fi dată fără îndoială în mîinile oştirilor regelui Babilonului, şi o vor lua".
translations.grk: Κύριος πόῤῥωθεν ὤφθη αὐτῷ· ἀγάπησιν αἰώνιον ἠγάπησά σε· διατοῦτο εἵλκυσά σε εἰς οἰκτείρημα.

verses.translation: For I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt yet take thy timbrel, and go forth with the party of them that make merry.

translations.ron: Atunci căpeteniile au zis către rege: "Omul acesta să fie dat morţii, pentru că el descurajează pe luptătorii care au rămas în cetatea aceasta şi pe tot poporul, spunându-le asemenea cuvinte. Căci omul acesta nu doreşte propăşirea poporului său, ci nenorocirea".
translations.grk: Ὅτι οἰκοδομήσω σε, καὶ οἰκοδομηθήσῃ παρθένος Ἰσραήλ· ἔπι λήψῃ τύμπανόν σου, καὶ ἐξελεύσῃ μετὰ συναγωγῆς παιζόντων.

verses.translation: For ye have planted vineyards on the mountains of Samaria: plant ye, and praise.

translations.ron: Iar regele Sedechia a zis: "Iată e în mâinile voastre, căci regele nu poate să facă nimic împotriva voastră".
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐφυτεύσατε ἀμπελῶνας ἐν ὄρεσι Σαμαρείας, φυτεύσατε καὶ αἰνέσατε,

verses.translation: For it is a day when those that plead on the mountains of Ephraim shall call, saying, Arise ye, and go up to Sion to the Lord your God.

translations.ron: Atunci au luat pe Ieremia şi l-au aruncat în groapa lui Malchia, fiul regelui, care era în curtea temniţii, coborându-l în ea cu funii. în groapa aceea nu era apă, ci numai noroi şi s-a afundat Ieremia în noroi.
translations.grk: ὅτι ἐστὶν ἡμέρα κλήσεως ἀπολογουμένων ἐν ὄρεσιν Ἐφραὶμ, ἀνάστητε, καὶ ἀνάβητε εἰς Σιὼν πρὸς Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ὑμῶν.

verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord to Jacob; Rejoice ye, and exult over the head of the nations: make proclamation, and praise ye: say, The Lord has delivered his people, the remnant of Israel.

translations.ron: Ebed-Melec, Etiopianul, unul din eunucii care se aflau în casa regelui, auzind că Ieremia a fost aruncat în groapă - regele atunci şedea la poarta lui Veniamin -
translations.grk: Ὅτι οὕτως εἶπε Κύριος τῷ Ἰακὼβ, εὐφράνθητε, καὶ χρεμετίσατε ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν ἐθνῶν· ἀκουστὰ ποιήσατε, καὶ αἰνέσατε· εἴπατε, ἔσωσε Κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, τὸ κατάλοιπον τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: Behold, I bring them from the north, and will gather them from the end of the earth to the feast of the passover: and the people shall beget a great multitude, and they shall return hither.

translations.ron: A ieşit din palatul regal şi a zis către rege:
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἄγω αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ Βοῤῥᾶ, καὶ συνάξω αὐτοὺς ἀπʼ ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς ἐν ἑορτῇ φασέκ· καὶ τεκνοποιήσει ὄχλον πολὺν, καὶ ἀποστρέψουσιν ὧδε.

verses.translation: They went forth with weeping, and I will bring them back with consolation, causing them to lodge by the channels of waters in a straight way, and they shall not err in it: for I am become a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my first-born.

translations.ron: "Domnul meu rege, rău au făcut oamenii aceştia care s-au purtat aşa cu Ieremia proorocul, pe care l-au aruncat în groapă. El va muri acolo de foame, pentru că nu mai este pâine în cetate".
translations.grk: Ἐν κλαυθμῷ ἐξῆλθον, καὶ ἐν παρακλήσει ἀνάξω αὐτοὺς, αὐλίζων ἐπὶ διώρυγας ὑδάτων ἐν ὁδῷ ὀρθῇ, καὶ οὐ μὴ πλανηθῶσιν ἐν αὐτῇ· ὅτι ἐγενόμην τῷ Ἰσραὴλ εἰς πατέρα, καὶ Ἐφραὶμ πρωτότοκός μου ἐστίν.

verses.translation: Hear the words of the Lord, ye nations, and proclaim them to the islands afar off; say, He that scattered Israel will also gather him, and keep him as one that feeds his flock.

translations.ron: Atunci regele a dat poruncă lui Ebed-Melec, Etiopianul, zicând: "Ia de aici treizeci de oameni şi scoate pe Ieremia proorocul din groapă, până nu moare".
translations.grk: Ἀκούσατε λόγους Κυρίου ἔθνη, καὶ ἀναγγείλατε εἰς νήσους τὰς μακρόθεν· εἴπατε, ὁ λικμήσας τὸν Ἰσραὴλ καὶ συνάξει αὐτὸν, καὶ φυλάξει αὐτὸν, ὡς ὁ βόσκων ποίμνιον αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: For the Lord has ransomed Jacob, he has rescued him out of the hand of them that were stronger than he.

translations.ron: Şi a luat Ebed-Melec cu sine oamenii şi a intrat în palatul regal, în veşmântărie, şi a luat de acolo bucăţi de haine vechi şi rupturi şi le-a dat drumul cu frânghia în groapă la Ieremia.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐλυτρώσατο Κύριος τὸν Ἰακὼβ, ἐξείλατο αὐτὸν ἐκ χειρὸς στερεωτέρων αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And they shall come, and shall rejoice in the mount of Sion, and shall come to the good things of the Lord, even to a land of corn, and wine, and fruits, and cattle, and sheep: and their soul shall be as a fruitful tree; and they shall hunger no more.

translations.ron: Şi a zis Ebed-Melec, Etiopianul, către Ieremia: "Pune aceste cârpe şi rupturi vechi, ce ţi s-au aruncat, la subsuorile tale, sub frânghie"; şi a făcut Ieremia aşa.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἥξουσι, καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σιὼν, καὶ ἥξουσιν ἐπʼ ἀγαθὰ Κυρίου, ἐπὶ γῆν σίτου καὶ οἴνου, καὶ καρπῶν, καὶ κτηνῶν, καὶ προβάτων· καὶ ἔσται ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν ὥσπερ ξύλον ἔγκαρπον, καὶ οὐ πεινάσουσιν ἔτι.

verses.translation: Then shall the virgins rejoice in the assembly of youth, and the old men shall rejoice; and I will turn their mourning into joy, and will make them merry.

translations.ron: Şi au tras pe Ieremia din groapă; şi a rămas Ieremia în curtea temniţii.
translations.grk: Τότε χαρήσονται παρθένοι ἐν συναγωγῇ νεανίσκων, καὶ πρεσβύται χαρήσονται, καὶ στρέψω τὸ πένθος αὐτῶν εἰς χαρμονὴν, καὶ ποιήσω αὐτοὺς εὐφραινομένους.

verses.translation: I will expand and cheer with wine the soul of the priests the sons of Levi, and my people shall be satisfied with my good things: thus saith the Lord.

translations.ron: Atunci regele Sedechia a trimis şi a chemat pe Ieremia proorocul la sine, la uşa a treia a templului Domnului; şi a zis regele către Ieremia: "Am să te întreb ceva, dar să nu ascunzi nimic de mine".
translations.grk: Μεγαλυνῶ καὶ μεθύσω τὴν ψυχὴν τῶν ἱερεων υἱῶν Λευὶ, καὶ ὁ λαός μου τῶν ἀγαθῶν μου ἐμπλησθήσεται· οὕτως εἶπε Κύριος.

verses.translation: A voice was heard in Rama, of lamentation, and of weeping, and wailing; Rachel would not cease weeping for her children, because they are not.

translations.ron: Iar Ieremia a zis către Sedechia: "Dacă-ţi voi descoperi, nu mă vei da oare morţii? Şi de-ţi voi da sfat, îl vei asculta tu oare?"
translations.grk: Φωνὴ ἐν Ῥαμᾷ ἠκούσθη θρήνου, καὶ κλαυθμοῦ, καὶ ὀδυρμοῦ· Ῥαχὴλ ἀποκλαιομένη οὐκ ἤθελε παύσασθαι ἐπὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῆς, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσίν.

verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord; Let thy voice cease from weeping, and thine eyes from thy tears: for there is a reward for thy works; and they shall return from the land of thine enemies.

translations.ron: Zis-a regele Sedechia către Ieremia: "Viu este Domnul, Care ne-a dat această viaţă, nu te voi da la moarte, nici în mâinile acestor oameni, care vor să-ţi ia viaţa, nu te voi da".
translations.grk: Οὕτως εἶπε Κύριος, διαλειπέτω ἡ φωνή σου ἀπὸ κλαυθμοῦ, καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου ἀπὸ δακρύων σου, ὅτι ἔστι μισθὸς τοῖς σοῖς ἔργοις, καὶ ἐπιστρέψουσιν ἐκ γῆς ἐχθρῶν,

verses.translation: There shall be an abiding home for thy children.

translations.ron: Atunci a zis Ieremia către Sedechia: "Aşa zice Domnul Dumnezeul Savaot, Dumnezeul lui Israel: Dacă tu vei ieşi la căpeteniile regelui Babilonului, vei scăpa cu viaţă şi cetatea aceasta nu va fi arsă cu foc şi vei trăi şi tu şi casa ta;
translations.grk: μόνιμον τοῖς σοῖς τέκνοις.

verses.translation: I have heard the sound of Ephraim lamenting, and saying, Thou hast chastened me, and I was chastened; I as a calf was not willingly taught: turn thou me, and I shall turn; for thou art the Lord my God.

translations.ron: Iar de nu vei ieşi la căpeteniile regelui Babilonului, cetatea aceasta va fi dată în mâinile Caldeilor, care o vor arde cu foc, şi nici tu nu vei scăpa din mâinile lor".
translations.grk: Ἀκοὴν ἤκουσα Ἐφραὶμ ὀδυρομένου, ἐπαίδευσάς με, καὶ ἐπαιδεύθην· ἐγὼ ὥσπερ μόσχος οὐκ ἐδιδάχθην· ἐπίστρεψόν με, καὶ ἐπιστρέψω, ὅτι σὺ Κύριος ὁ Θεός μου.

verses.translation: For after my captivity I repented; and after I knew, I groaned for the day of shame, and shewed thee that I bore reproach from my youth.

translations.ron: Iar regele Sedechia a zis către Ieremia: "Mă tem de Iudeii care au trecut la Caldei, ca nu cumva să nu fiu dat de Caldei pe mâna lor şi ca nu cumva aceia să-şi bată, joc de mine".
translations.grk: Ὅτι ὕστερον αἰχμαλωσίας μου μετενόησα, καὶ ὕστερον τοῦ γνῶναί με, ἐστέναξα ἐφʼ ἡμέρας αἰσχύνης, καὶ ὑπέδειξά σοι, ὅτι ἔλαβον ὀνειδισμὸν ἐκ νεότητός μου.

verses.translation: Ephraim is a beloved son, a pleasing child to me: for because my words are in him, I will surely remember him: therefore I made haste to help him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the Lord.

translations.ron: Zis-a Ieremia: "Nu te vor da! Ascultă glasul Domnului în cele ce-ţi grăiesc eu şi bine-ţi va fi şi sufletul tău va fi viu.
translations.grk: Υἱὸς ἀγαπητὸς Ἐφραὶμ, ἐμοὶ παιδίον ἐντρυφῶν, ὅτι ἀνθʼ ὧν οἱ λόγοι μου ἐν αὐτῷ, μνείᾳ μνησθήσομαι αὐτοῦ· διατοῦτο ἔσπευσα ἐπʼ αὐτῷ, ἐλεῶν ἐλεήσω αὐτὸν, φησὶ Κύριος.

verses.translation: Prepare thyself, O Sion; execute vengeance; look to thy ways: return, O virgin of Israel, by the way by which thou wentest, return mourning to thy cities.

translations.ron: Iar dacă tu nu vei vrea să ieşi, atunci iată cuvântul pe care mi l-a descoperit Domnul:
translations.grk: Στῆσον σεαυτὴν Σιὼν, ποίησον τιμωρίαν, δὸς καρδίαν σου εἰς τοὺς ὤμους· ὁδὸν ᾗ ἐπορεύθης, ἀποστράφηθι παρθένος Ἰσραὴλ, ἀποστράφητι εἰς τὰς πόλεις σου πενθοῦσα.

verses.translation: How long, O disgraced daughter, wilt thou turn away? for the Lord has created safety for a new plantation: men shall go about in safety.

translations.ron: Toate femeile care au rămas în casa regelui lui Iuda var fi duse la căpeteniile regelui Babilonului şi acelea vor zice: Te-au amăgit şi te-au înşelat bunii tăi prieteni; piciorul tău s-a afundat în noroi şi aceştia au fugit de tine;
translations.grk: Ἕως πότε ἀποστρέψεις θυγάτηρ ἠτιμωμένη; ὅτι ἔκτισε Κύριος σωτηρίαν εἰς καταφύτευσιν καινὴν, ἐν σωτηρίᾳ περιελεύσονται ἄνθρωποι.

verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord; They shall yet speak this word in the land of Juda, and in the cities thereof, when I shall turn his captivity; blessed be the Lord on his righteous holy mountain!

translations.ron: Şi toate femeile tale şi copiii tăi vor fi daţi Caldeilor şi nici tu nu vei scăpa din mâinile lor, căci vei fi prins de mâna regelui Babilonului şi această cetate va fi arsă".
translations.grk: Ὅτι οὕτως εἶπε Κύριος, ἔτι ἐροῦσι τὸν λόγον τοῦτον ἐν γῇ Ἰούδα, καὶ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτοῦ, ὅταν ἀποστρέψω τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν αὐτοῦ, εὐλογημένος Κύριος ἐπὶ δίκαιον ὄρος τὸ ἅγιον αὐτοῦ·

verses.translation: And there shall be dwellers in the cities of Juda, and in all his land, together with the husbandman, and the shepherd shall go forth with the flock.

translations.ron: Zis-e Sedechia către Ieremia: "Nimeni nu trebuie să ştie cuvintele acestea şi atunci tu nu vei muri.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐνοικοῦντες ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν Ἰούδα, καὶ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ, ἅμα γεωργῷ, καὶ ἀρθήσεται ἐν ποιμνίῳ.

verses.translation: For I have saturated every thirsting soul, and filled every hungry soul.

translations.ron: Iar de vor auzi căpeteniile că eu am grăit cu tine şi de vor veni la tine şi-ţi vor zice: "Spune-ne ce ai vorbit cu regele? Nu ascunde de noi şi nu te vom da la moarte! Şi ce ţi-e vorbit regele?"
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐμέθυσα πᾶσαν ψυχὴν διψῶσαν, καὶ πᾶσαν ψυχὴν πεινῶσαν ἐνέπλησα.

verses.translation: Therefore I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet to me.

translations.ron: Atunci să le spui: Am prezentat înaintea regelui cererea mea, ca să nu mă trimită înapoi în casa lui Ionatan şi să mor acolo".
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο ἐξηγέρθην, καὶ εἶδον, καὶ ὁ ὕπνος μου ἡδύς μοι ἐγενήθη.

verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Juda with the seed of man, and the seed of beast.

translations.ron: Atunci au venit toţi dregătorii la Ieremia şi l-au întrebat, iar el le-a răspuns întocmai cum îi poruncise regele, şi aceia, tăcând, l-au lăsat, pentru că n-au aflat nimic.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται, φησὶ Κύριος, καὶ σπερῶ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ καὶ τὸν Ἰούδαν, σπέρμα ἀνθρώπου καὶ σπέρμα κτήνους.

verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that as I watched over them, to pull down, and to afflict, so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the Lord.

translations.ron: Şi a rămas Ieremia în curtea temniţii până în ziua în care a fost luat Ierusalimul, căci Ierusalimul a fost luat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ὥσπερ ἐγρηγόρουν ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς καθαιρεῖν καὶ κακοῦν, οὕτως γρηγορήσω ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς τοῦ οἰκοδομεῖν καὶ καταφυτεύειν, φησὶ Κύριος.

verses.translation: In those days they shall certainly not say, The fathers ate a sour grape, and the children's teeth were set on edge.
But every one shall die in his own sin; and the teeth of him that eats the sour grape shall be set on edge.
Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Juda:

not according to the covenant which I made with their fathers in the day when I took hold of their hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; for they abode not in my covenant, and I disregarded them, saith the Lord.

For this is my covenant which I will make with the house of Israel; after those days, saith the Lord, I will surely put my laws into their mind, and write them on their hearts; and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people.

And they shall not at all teach every one his fellow citizen, and every one his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least of them to the greatest of them: for I will be merciful to their iniquities, and their sins I will remember no more.

Though the sky should be raised to a greater height, saith the Lord, and though the ground of the earth should be sunk lower beneath, yet I will not cast off the family of Israel, saith the Lord, for all that they have done.
Thus saith the Lord, who gives the sun for a light by day, the moon and the stars for a light by night, and makes a roaring in the sea, so that the waves thereof roar; the Lord Almighty is his name:
if these ordinances cease from before me, saith the Lord, then shall the family of Israel cease to be a nation before me for ever.
Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when the city shall be built to the Lord from the tower of Anameel to the gate of the corner.
And the measurement of it shall proceed in front of them as far as the hills of Gareb, and it shall be compassed with a circular wall of choice stones.
And all the Asaremoth even to Nachal Kedron, as far as the corner of the horse-gate eastward, shall be holiness to the Lord; and it shall not fail any more, and shall not be destroyed for ever.
